acceptance_criteria: Only the three allowlisted files may change; do not edit the Ollama service, gateway, adapter, legacy import, ToolLoopRunner, ToolCallAdapter, resolver, or flag files.
OllamaLocalTransport must implement the BaseTransport send, tool-normalization, and second-call-history seams by delegating to an injected existing Ollama service seam.

The wrapper must not transform local endpoint/model-node routing, capability behavior, requests, responses, metadata, tool results, history, retry/deadline behavior, native-tool fallback, response normalization, or streaming behavior.
The focused test must use a fake or mocked service, make no network call, construct no OpenAI client, and require no credentials.
Do not enable or consume TRANSPORT_LAYER_ENABLED and do not integrate a caller.
